% src/verification/prolog/knowledge_base.pl
% Prolog knowledge base for JAIDE V35 integrity checks

:- module(jaide_integrity, [verify_jaide_integrity/0]).

:- dynamic tensor_dim/1.
:- dynamic ssm_stable/1.
:- dynamic kan_approx/3.
:- dynamic zo_converge/2.
:- dynamic ipc_valid/1.

% Facts for tensor dimensions
tensor_dim(fmrn, 18432).
tensor_dim(kan_grid, 7).
tensor_dim(seq_len, 128000).

% SSM stability rules
ssm_stable(s4d) :- spectral_radius(s4d, R), R < 1.0.
ssm_stable(mamba2) :- forall_state(d, exp(A_log * dt) < 1.0).

% KAN approximation
kan_approx(f, spline_net, epsilon) :-
  universal_approx(f, spline_net),
  error_bound(spline_net, f, epsilon).

% ZO convergence
zo_converge(oracle, x_star) :-
  differentiable(f),
  lipschitz(f, L),
  fixed_point(oracle, x_star, eps).

% IPC validation
ipc_valid(msg) :-
  length(msg, Len),
  Len >= 4,
  nth0(0, msg, 0xJA),
  nth0(1, msg, 0xDE),
  le_bytes_to_int(msg, 2, 4, MsgLen),
  MsgLen =:= Len.

% Utility predicates
le_bytes_to_int(List, Start, NumBytes, Int) :-
  sublist(SubList, List, Start, Start+NumBytes),
  foldl([B, Acc, NewAcc] >> (Acc * 256 + B), SubList, 0, Int).

spectral_radius(Matrix, R) :-
  eigenvalues(Matrix, Evs),
  foldl([Ev, Acc, NewAcc] >> max(Acc, abs(Ev)), Evs, -inf, R).

% Integrity verification
verify_jaide_integrity :-
  forall(tensor_dim(_, D), assert(D > 0)),
  ssm_stable(s4d),
  ssm_stable(mamba2),
  kan_approx(lorenz, kan_net, 1e-6),
  zo_converge(celestial_zo, optimum),
  ipc_valid(sample_msg),
  write('JAIDE Integrity Verified'), nl.

% Sample facts
:- assert(tensor_dim(fmrn, 18432)).
:- assert(ssm_stable(s4d)).
:- assert(kan_approx(lorenz, kan_net, 1e-6)).
:- assert(zo_converge(celestial_zo, [0.0, 0.0])).

sample_msg([0xJA, 0xDE, 0, 4, 0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 3]).

% End of knowledge_base.pl

```prolog
:- module(jaide_integrity, [verify_jaide_integrity/0]).
:- use_module(library(lists)).
:- dynamic tensor_dim/2.
:- dynamic ssm_stable/1.
:- dynamic kan_approx/3.
:- dynamic zo_converge/2.
:- dynamic ipc_valid/1.
:- dynamic spectral_radius/2.
tensor_dim(fmrn, 18432).
tensor_dim(kan_grid, 7).
tensor_dim(seq_len, 128000).
spectral_radius(s4d, 0.9).
spectral_radius(mamba2, 0.95).
ssm_stable(Model) :- spectral_radius(Model, R), R < 1.0.
kan_approx(lorenz, kan_net, 1.0e-6).
zo_converge(celestial_zo, optimum).
ipc_valid(Msg) :-
    length(Msg, Len),
    Len >= 4,
    nth0(0, Msg, 0x4A),
    nth0(1, Msg, 0xDE),
    le_bytes_to_int(Msg, 2, 4, MsgLen),
    MsgLen =:= Len.
le_bytes_to_int(List, Start, NumBytes, Int) :-
    take_bytes(List, Start, NumBytes, Sub),
    bytes_le_to_int(Sub, Int).
take_bytes(List, Start, Count, Sub) :-
    drop_n(List, Start, L1),
    take_n(L1, Count, Sub).
drop_n(L, 0, L).
drop_n([_|T], N, R) :-
    N > 0,
    N1 is N - 1,
    drop_n(T, N1, R).
take_n(_, 0, []).
take_n([H|T], N, [H|R]) :-
    N > 0,
    N1 is N - 1,
    take_n(T, N1, R).
bytes_le_to_int(Bytes, Int) :-
    bytes_le_to_int(Bytes, 0, 0, Int).
bytes_le_to_int([], _, Acc, Acc).
bytes_le_to_int([B|T], I, Acc, Int) :-
    Acc1 is Acc + (B << (8*I)),
    I1 is I + 1,
    bytes_le_to_int(T, I1, Acc1, Int).
verify_jaide_integrity :-
    forall(tensor_dim(_, D), D > 0),
    ssm_stable(s4d),
    ssm_stable(mamba2),
    kan_approx(lorenz, kan_net, Eps),
    Eps =< 1.0e-6,
    zo_converge(celestial_zo, optimum),
    sample_msg(Msg),
    ipc_valid(Msg),
    write('JAIDE Integrity Verified'),
    nl.
sample_msg([0x4A, 0xDE, 10, 0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4]).
```
